Name: Popcorn Machine
Author: failsplat
Description:
[size=3]Note: This mod depends on Artisan Valley, which is not being updated for SDV 1.6. Waiting for the the successor to Artisan Valley to come out for SDV v1.6.[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=6]Popcorn Machine (Mod for Stardew Valley)[/size]
Turn corn and a variety of toppings into popcorn!
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/13182/13182-1659235351-333051897.gif[/img]
[size=5]Required Mods[/size]
- Producer Framework Mod
- Json Assets

[size=5]Optional Mods (Unlock more flavors!)[/size]
[size=2]- PPJA More Recipes
- PPJA Even More Recipes
- PPJA Artisan Valley
[/size]
Flavors[/size]
All recipes use Corn to produce
- (Plain) Popcorn
- Butter (with Artisan Valley)
- Cheese
- Caramel (with Even More Recipes)
- Chocolate (with More Recipes)
- Kettle Corn (+Sugar)
- Hot Chili (+Hot Pepper)
- Truffle
- Maple
## Install
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).
2. Download this mod folder.
3. Put the unzipped content packs into `Stardew Valley/Mods` to install them.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
